findings.message: 4 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "The signature ingredient" above "Caviar, in every formula."; "Swiss science" above "Protect. Repair. Rejuvenate."; "The Ritual" above "Four steps. Nothing more."; "Step 1" above "Cleanse"; "Step 2" above "Treat"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 11 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Four caviar formulas. One complete ritua", "The signature ingredient", "Swiss science", "Instrument‑measured").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: figure.hxv__glass → rgb(251, 250, 247) 0px 0px 0px 11.52px | picture.hxs__pearl → rgba(28, 29, 31, 0.45) 0px 18px 36px -22px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 10 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): li.hxs__pillar.is-in 629px | li.hxs__pillar.is-in 629px | li.hxs__pillar.is-in 629px | p.hxs__method 389px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Made in Switzerland, to a single standard." → 3 lines (7 words, 44px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
